scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/server
scripts.start:production: concurrently -n web,server "npm run start -w apps/web" "npm run start -w apps/server"
scripts.production: npm run build && npm run start:production
